segments.normalizedSource: ```swift // Create the data types. let stepCountType = HKQuantityType(.stepCount) let pushCountType = HKQuantityType(.pushCount) // Specify the desired sample types. let stepDescriptor = HKQueryDescriptor(sampleType: stepCountType, predicate: nil) let pushDescriptor = HKQueryDescriptor(sampleType: pushCountType, predicate: nil) // Specify the sort descriptors. let startDateDescriptor = NSSortDescriptor(key: HKSampleSortIdentifierStartDate, ascending: true) // Create the query. let query = HKSampleQuery(queryDescriptors: [stepDescriptor, pushDescriptor], limit: HKObjectQueryNoLimit, sortDescriptors: [startDateDescriptor]) { (query, samples, error) in if let error = error { // Handle errors here. } DispatchQueue.main.async { // Process the samples here. } } // Run the query. store.execute(query) ```
